publication.reason: Der kanonische siebenfaktorige Vertrag ist festgelegt, aber Revisions-, Peer- und breite PIT-Evidenz sind noch nicht produktionsreif.

quality.label: Quality
quality.purpose: Durability, accounting quality and balance-sheet resilience; no profitability levels are reused.
quality.sectorTreatment: Generic formula is NOT_APPLICABLE for banks, insurers and REITs until separately versioned templates exist.
quality.missingDataPolicy: Invalid or unavailable inputs are null, never zero; legitimate negative values remain valid; available weights may renormalize only within the factor and must be disclosed.
quality.outlierHandling: Continuous inputs are winsorized at peer and universe 2nd/98th percentiles after validation; counts are not winsorized.
quality.pitRequirements: Use only filing observations with availableAt<=scoreCutoff; prefer acceptedAt, otherwise validated filedAt; later restatements remain invisible until their own availability.
quality.updateFrequency: Event-driven after accepted filing/materialized consumer update; nightly snapshot only when a dependency changed.
quality.interpretation: Higher means stronger accounting durability and balance-sheet resilience, not a recommendation.

growth.label: Growth
growth.purpose: Operating expansion and acceleration; changes rather than profitability levels.

components.input: diluted EPS CAGR; both endpoints positive
free cash flow CAGR; both endpoints positive
current revenue YoY growth-previous revenue YoY growth

growth.sectorTreatment: Industry then sector then universe normalization; no invented classification.
growth.missingDataPolicy: Cross-zero EPS or FCF CAGR is null; invalid inputs are never zero; within-factor renormalization is disclosed.
growth.outlierHandling: Continuous inputs are winsorized at peer and universe 2nd/98th percentiles after validation.
growth.pitRequirements: All endpoints must have been available by scoreCutoff; use period identity and acceptedAt/filedAt lifecycle.
growth.updateFrequency: Event-driven after accepted filing/materialized consumer update.
growth.interpretation: Higher means stronger realized operating expansion, not expected revisions or a recommendation.

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.purpose: Medium-horizon total-return strength and market confirmation.

components.input: security 12-1 total return minus certified broad benchmark 12-1 total return

momentum.sectorTreatment: Industry then sector then universe normalization; no invented classification.
momentum.missingDataPolicy: Insufficient or semantically ambiguous price history is null; TOTAL_RETURN and SPLIT_ADJUSTED bases may not be aliased.
momentum.outlierHandling: Continuous inputs are winsorized at peer and universe 2nd/98th percentiles after semantic validation.
momentum.pitRequirements: Use only final bars available before scoreCutoff and the certified benchmark observation aligned to each security date.
momentum.interpretation: Higher means stronger recent market confirmation, not a forecast or recommendation.

value.label: Value
value.purpose: Price relative to current PIT-safe business fundamentals.
value.sectorTreatment: Industry then sector then universe normalization; industry-specific applicability remains explicit.
value.missingDataPolicy: Negative earnings and FCF yields are valid adverse values; EV metrics require positive finite EV; negative equity makes bookToMarket unavailable.
value.outlierHandling: Continuous inputs are winsorized at peer and universe 2nd/98th percentiles after validation.
value.pitRequirements: Price, shares, cash and debt must be the latest values known at scoreCutoff; no today-known values in historical scores.
value.updateFrequency: After completed EOD close or accepted filing when a dependency changed.
value.interpretation: Higher means cheaper relative valuation within the eligible universe, not intrinsic value certainty.

profitability.label: Profitability
profitability.purpose: Current and persistent operating profitability; excludes balance-sheet safety and accounting-quality components.

components.input: canonical return on invested capital; tax assumption disclosed

profitability.sectorTreatment: Industry then sector then universe normalization; industry-specific applicability remains explicit.
profitability.missingDataPolicy: Negative margins and returns are valid adverse values; invalid denominators are null; within-factor renormalization is disclosed.
profitability.outlierHandling: Continuous inputs are winsorized at peer and universe 2nd/98th percentiles after validation.
profitability.pitRequirements: Use only PIT-safe TTM and annual observations known at scoreCutoff.
profitability.updateFrequency: Event-driven after accepted filing/materialized consumer update.
profitability.interpretation: Higher means stronger current and persistent operating economics, not accounting quality or a recommendation.

revisions.label: Revisions
revisions.purpose: Changes in analyst expectations; SEC restatements and filing revisions are explicitly not this factor.

components.input: (current FY1 EPS consensus-prior consensus)/baseline share price
(current FY2 EPS consensus-prior consensus)/baseline share price
percentage change in FY1 revenue consensus
latest one-month FY1 EPS revision yield-preceding one-month yield
standard deviation of FY1 EPS estimates/share price

revisions.sectorTreatment: Industry then sector then universe normalization; no invented classification.
revisions.missingDataPolicy: Without licensed immutable PIT consensus snapshots the entire factor is UNAVAILABLE; no proxy and no factor-weight redistribution.
revisions.outlierHandling: Continuous inputs are winsorized at peer and universe 2nd/98th percentiles after validation; breadth is bounded and not winsorized.
revisions.pitRequirements: Same fiscal-period identity; actual provider publication timestamp; immutable current and baseline snapshots; corporate-action-adjusted per-share estimates; never reconstruct from today's history.
revisions.updateFrequency: Event-driven after a valid provider snapshot; nightly score snapshot only when dependency changed.
revisions.interpretation: Higher means improving analyst expectations, not a restatement signal or recommendation.
revisions.blocker: No licensed, certified historical PIT analyst-consensus source is present.

risk.label: Risk
risk.purpose: Historical market risk; a higher score always means lower observed risk.

components.input: annualized volatility of negative daily returns

risk.sectorTreatment: Industry then sector then universe normalization; no invented classification.
risk.missingDataPolicy: Insufficient or unaligned return history is null, never zero; within-factor renormalization is disclosed.
risk.outlierHandling: Continuous inputs are winsorized at peer and universe 2nd/98th percentiles after validation.
risk.pitRequirements: Only final total-return bars available before scoreCutoff and an aligned certified benchmark may be used.
risk.interpretation: Higher means lower observed historical market risk, not safety or a forecast.

requirements: product-eligible active US common equity or accepted ADR

normalization.unknownClassificationPolicy: Do not invent a classification; use documented universe fallback only when its minimum size is met.

score.quantScore: deterministic percentile rank of compositeScore in eligible score universe
score.semantics: Relative rank, not a probability, target price or recommendation.

temporal.currentMaterialization: nightly only if a dependency changed
temporal.canonicalHistory: immutable weekly snapshot using the final completed session
temporal.eventSnapshots: optional after material filing or large valid revision; never replace weekly history

knownGates: historical PIT universe membership and classifications
industry templates for banks, insurers and REITs
broad component coverage and cross-sectional validation
